title: Click Holdings Limited Reports Strong Growth in the First Half of 2024 Financial Results
description: Click Holdings Limited, a human resources solutions provider in Hong Kong, reported a 14.3% increase in total revenue and a 25% increase in net income for the first half of 2024. The company saw steady growth across its professional, nursing, and logistics solution services.

title: CLICK announced to expand service to the Community Care Service Voucher scheme for elderly (CCSV scheme) in Hong Kong
description: CLICK Holdings Limited has signed a cooperation agreement with Care U Professional Nursing Service Limited to jointly provide integrated home-based services for the elderly under the government-sponsored Community Care Service Voucher (CCSV) scheme in Hong Kong.
